# Eastern Suburbs Banksia Scrub of the Sydney Region

Conservation status in NSW: Not listed￼

Commonwealth status: [Critically Endangered](https://www.dcceew.gov.au/environment/biodiversity/threatened/species#categories)￼

A profile for this Threatened Ecological Community is available from [NSW Office of Environment & Heritage](https://threatenedspecies.bionet.nsw.gov.au/profile?id=20413)
